objectives_and_floor: Original packet-risk objective and monotone physical expected-byte score; ceil(.90*own original draft dequeue)
offline: Every post-warmup saved state from risk_neural and greedy validation trajectories for seeds48/50; same-state paired solvers; report all methods and full work/cost; no result-dependent state removal
coverage_audit: All graph blocks at neural-origin TTI2001/3001/4000 for each seed; common frozen incumbent; physical teacher only for measuring candidate recall, never injected into the neural shortlist
quality_gate: Both validation seeds must have success-delay mean and all-outcome mean no larger than frozen neural reference, full-packet payload no smaller, TTL expiry no larger; report direct physical gap separately. This is a strict descriptive validation screen, not a statistical noninferiority test.
cost: Every prefix PHY evaluation uses the search evaluator and its candidate counter/budget; report shortlist cap, actual physical candidates, actor option scores, proposal count and serial search wall time separately
interpretation: Exact prefix values are the existing native physical verifier, not a newly trained learned critic or an LLM invocation. Research ideas are adapted, not paper reproductions.
unseen_final_tests: Not run in this validation iteration; any subsequent final test needs frozen new seeds and the five-second protocol
